notes.title: The "Refinement" Update!
notes.content:
Welcome to the Refinement update!
This update is technically the first half of the quote "bigger release on its way", with refinements, new towers and visual improvements to boot. Coming updates will have larger adjustments.


New Content:

Tower Tech Tree
Added a Tower Tech Tree, now you have to research towers in proper order!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602158/c4f559cfc77b82d4e538b45307e6c1c5463c1b5e.png"]

Pressing the "Tower Tree" button on the top of the page returns you to the regular Tower Select mode. 



( Small sneak peek of some of the new towers ;) )
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602158/81de126a8edce1614981cf863980cd7ba440d6ba.png"]Zombie "Info" panel
Now also with a much better info system for zombies:[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602158/77250c1b1d7d698b085db74eb71fecc37fc3fb98.png"]

In this example you can see what the "zombie" is strong against (taking 67% less damage from bullets) and weak against (taking 50% more damage from explosions).


Changelog:
Additions:

*  Big Addition, Hidden enemies!



Added Shotgunner

Added Flamethrower

Added Dinghy



Added Fire resistance

Added display for all resistances





Adjustments:

Adjusted: Upgrade menu, added not-so-descriptive descriptions for each upgrade.

Adjusted: Certain towers to have hidden detection, along with their stats adjusted to compensate for having hidden detection.

Adjusted: The first two (, and for now only) difficulties have been nerfed in difficulty, giving the player more cash per wave.



Nerf: Overall weakening and rebalancing of Gunner.

Nerf: Overall weakening and rebalancing of Laser unit.

Nerf: Overall weakening and rebalancing of Commando.



Thank you for reading :D

notes.title: The "In Between" Update!!
notes.content:
Welcome to the "In Between" Update!!

This is a small update leading up to the bigger release on its way, currently development is slowing down for a couple of weeks, expected to pick back up at the end of may leading to a big release somewhere next month!

New Content!!
Enjoy the two new "Heavy" towers added to the game, the Commando and Tanker, as well as the new (sort of) scenic day and night cycle!{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602158/dbd47474e6ee65b6471d8a2b190c72e5dd18acdd.png
Sneak peek screenshot!

Changelogs:
Additions / Tweaks:
Added 2 towers
Added day and night cycle
Reworked shadows to be more "pretty" (from blob to "drop" shadows)

Balance changes:
Nerf: Snipers "Railgun" upgrade now deals less damage (800 -> 600)
Nerf: Gunners "Better Rifle" upgrade now costs more (1050 -> 1250)

Gameplay change: Wave 0 now has a skip timer set to 5 seconds on every difficulty, meaning you can skip almost instantly on starting a new game.
